subject.title: [Bug]: Telegram DMs can still land in agent:main:main, polluting heartbeat/main session after #40519

question: Should this issue be scoped to fixing explicit `heartbeat.session` precedence for wake-triggered heartbeats, or should it also change Telegram DM default session isolation?
rationale: The source-backed bug is the explicit heartbeat session losing to an originating session, while default Telegram DM isolation would change documented `session.dmScope=main` behavior for existing users.

options.title: Fix heartbeat precedence only
options.body: Make configured `heartbeat.session` win over wake-origin sessions, add focused regression coverage, and keep documented DM defaults unchanged.

options.title: Broaden to DM default isolation
options.body: Treat this as a compatibility-sensitive product change that changes Telegram DM defaults with docs, migration guidance, and upgrade proof.

options.title: Require live repro first
options.body: Pause code work until maintainers or users provide a current-main Telegram heartbeat/exec-event reproduction beyond source inspection.

recommendation.title: Fix heartbeat precedence only
recommendation.body: Make configured `heartbeat.session` win over wake-origin sessions, add focused regression coverage, and keep documented DM defaults unchanged.

likelyOwner.reason: They owned the adjacent merged Telegram DM dedupe boundary that this issue explicitly follows up on.
